verdict.rationale: Clara's own marketing claims built-in automation: automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance, and an "automated CFO agent" via Clara Intelligence. Its docs show a few configured background behaviors, such as scheduled card auto-deletion at a period end date and daily/weekly/monthly limit resets. The API, webhooks and MCP are developer building blocks or interactive tools, so they earn no credit here, and nothing documents a user-facing way to define autonomous automations. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation/workflow builder, details of how the CFO agent or automated approvals run unattended, triggers/schedules beyond card settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
